models_evaluated: SOS Dental Trauma chatbot (WhatsApp, FastAPI, Twilio)

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness against a predefined 90% threshold in simulated cases, with revision and retest
links.effect: Permanent dentition met 100% accuracy and completeness initially. Primary dentition fell below the 90% threshold (luxation, displacement). After prompt revisions, all trauma types reached 100%.
links.quote: Nevertheless, it fell below the threshold in cases of primary dentition, particularly luxation and displacement, due to oversimplification of management options.

unlisted_practices: Expert panel review of chatbot interaction flow (clarity, appropriateness, coherence) leading to redesign of question formulation
Restricting chatbot to a structured clinical script limited to dental trauma first-aid guidance
Delivering first-aid chatbot guidance through WhatsApp

screen.reason: The study develops and tests the clinical accuracy and completeness of a WhatsApp-based dental trauma chatbot using expert review and simulated clinical scenarios.
